headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 26, 2026**
article:
The Houston Astros suffered a tough 8-0 loss to the Detroit Tigers, who were led by Keider Montero's strong pitching performance. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 6-4 behind Noelvi Marte's fourth home run of the season.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Jesús Sánchez, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right ankle sprain. Other players on the injured list include Daniel Susac, Phil Maton, Marcelo Mayer, Robert Suarez, Wenceel Pérez, Tony Santillan, and Ryne Nelson.

The Chicago Cubs made a notable trade, acquiring left-handed pitcher David Peterson from the New York Mets in exchange for third baseman Cole Mathis.

top_news.title: **Astros Fall to Tigers in Dominant 8-0 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros suffered a tough defeat at the hands of the Detroit Tigers, who won 8-0 behind a strong pitching performance. Keider Montero led the Tigers' staff with 7.0 innings pitched, 3 strikeouts, and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Pirates 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Noelvi Marte leading the offense. Marte hit his fourth home run of the season, a line drive to left center field, scoring Sal Stewart.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall to Orioles in 1-3 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals suffered a 1-3 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with Trevor Rogers earning the win after 6.1 innings of work. Rogers struck out 7 batters and allowed just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Rangers Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling 5-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers took down the Toronto Blue Jays in a close game, winning 5-4. Nathan Eovaldi led the Rangers to victory with a strong 7.0 innings pitched, striking out 9 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Jesús Sánchez Placed on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays right fielder Jesús Sánchez has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right ankle sprain.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired left-handed pitcher David Peterson from the New York Mets in exchange for third baseman Cole Mathis.
